hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to visit me during the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage when I was suffering from a severe illness. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, my illness has become severe as you see, and I am a man of wealth and no one inherits from me except a daughter. Shall I give two-thirds of my wealth in charity?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'No.' I said: 'Then half?' He said: 'No.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'One-third, and one-third is a lot. Indeed, that you leave your heirs wealthy is better than leaving them poor, begging from people. And you will not spend any expenditure seeking thereby the Face of Allah except that you will be rewarded for it, even for what you put in your wife's mouth.' He (Sa'd) said: I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, will I be left behind after my companions?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'You will not be left behind and do any righteous deed except that you will increase in rank and elevation because of it. Perhaps you will be left behind so that some people may benefit from you and others may be harmed by you. O Allah, complete for my Companions their migration and do not turn them back on their heels. But wretched is Sa'd ibn Khawlah,' for whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ felt sorrow that he died in Mecca.

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : جَاءَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَعُودُنِي عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ مِنْ وَجَعٍ اشْتَدَّ بِي ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، قَدْ بَلَغَ بِي مِنَ الْوَجَعِ مَا تَرَى ، وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ وَلَا يَرِثُنِي إِلَّا ابْنَةٌ لِي ، أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَيْ مَالِي ؟ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَا " . فَقُلْتُ : فَالشَّطْرُ ؟ قَالَ : " لَا " . ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " الثُّلُثُ ، وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ ، إِنَّكَ أَنْ تَذَرَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ ، خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَذَرَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ ، وَإِنَّكَ لَنْ تُنْفِقَ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا أُجِرْتَ حَتَّى مَا تَجْعَلُ فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ " . قَالَ : فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، أَأُخَلَّفُ بَعْدَ أَصْحَابِي ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّكَ لَنْ تُخَلَّفَ فَتَعْمَلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا ، إِلَّا ازْدَدْتَ بِهِ دَرَجَةً وَرِفْعَةً ، وَلَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تُخَلَّفَ حَتَّى يَنْتَفِعَ بِكَ أَقْوَامٌ وَيُضَرَّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ . اللَّهُمَّ أَمْضِ لِأَصْحَابِي هِجْرَتَهُمْ ، وَلَا تَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ . لَكِنْ الْبَائِسُ سَعْدُ بْنُ خَوْلَةَ يَرْثِي لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ مَاتَ بِمَكَّةَ "

hadiths.english_translation: Yahya said: I heard Malik saying: The best that I have heard concerning the bequest of a pregnant woman and her judgments regarding her wealth and what is permissible for her, is that the pregnant woman is like the sick person. When the illness is light and not feared for its bearer, then its bearer may do with his wealth whatever he wishes. And when the illness is feared for him, then nothing is permissible for its bearer except in his one-third. He said: And likewise the pregnant woman at the beginning of her pregnancy is joy and happiness and it is not an illness nor feared for her, so she may dispose of her wealth as she wishes. And when her delivery time comes and labor pains afflict her, then she becomes like one who is feared for, and nothing is permissible for her from her wealth except in her one-third.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ يَحْيَى : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا ، يَقُولُ : أَحْسَنُ مَا سَمِعْتُ فِي وَصِيَّةِ الْحَامِلِ وَفِي قَضَايَاهَا فِي مَالِهَا وَمَا يَجُوزُ لَهَا ، أَنَّ الْحَامِلَ كَالْمَرِيضِ ، فَإِذَا كَانَ الْمَرَضُ الْخَفِيفُ غَيْرُ الْمَخُوفِ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ ، فَإِنَّ صَاحِبَهُ يَصْنَعُ فِي مَالِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ ، وَإِذَا كَانَ الْمَرَضُ الْمَخُوفُ عَلَيْهِ ، لَمْ يَجُزْ لِصَاحِبِهِ شَيْءٌ إِلَّا فِي ثُلُثِهِ ، قَالَ : وَكَذَلِكَ الْمَرْأَةُ الْحَامِلُ أَوَّلُ حَمْلِهَا بِشْرٌ وَسُرُورٌ وَلَيْسَ بِمَرَضٍ وَلَا يُخَافُ عَلَيْهَا فَتَصْنَعُ فِي مَالِهَا مَا تَشَاءُ ، فَإِذَا حَانَ وِلَادُهَا وَأَصَابَهَا الطَّلْقُ ، فَإِنَّهَا صَارَتْ مَخُوفًا عَلَيْهَا ، فَلَا يَجُوزُ لَهَا مِنْ مَالِهَا إِلَّا فِي ثُلُثِهَا

hadiths.english_translation: Yahya said: I heard Malik saying regarding this verse: That it is abrogated, the saying of Allah the Blessed and Exalted: 'If he leaves wealth, the bequest is for parents and near relatives' [Quran 2:180]. It was abrogated by what was revealed of the division of inheritance (fara'id) in the Book of Allah the Mighty and Majestic. He said: And I heard Malik saying: The established Sunnah with us in which there is no disagreement, is that no bequest is permissible for an heir, unless the heirs of the deceased permit it for him.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ يَحْيَى : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا ، يَقُولُ فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ : إِنَّهَا مَنْسُوخَةٌ ، قَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى : إِنْ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالأَقْرَبِينَ سورة البقرة آية 180 ، نَسَخَهَا مَا نَزَلَ مِنْ قِسْمَةِ الْفَرَائِضِ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ . قَالَ : وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا ، يَقُولُ : السُّنَّةُ الثَّابِتَةُ عِنْدَنَا الَّتِي لَا اخْتِلَافَ فِيهَا ، أَنَّهُ لَا تَجُوزُ وَصِيَّةٌ لِوَارِثٍ ، إِلَّا أَنْ يُجِيزَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ وَرَثَةُ الْمَيِّتِ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Urwah ibn al-Zubayr: An effeminate man (mukhannath) was with Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ. He said to Abdullah ibn Abi Umayyah while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was listening: 'O Abdullah, if Allah grants you victory over Taif tomorrow, then I will guide you to the daughter of Ghaylan, for she comes forward with four (folds of fat) and turns back with eight.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'These (effeminate men) should not enter upon you (women).'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّ مُخَنَّثًا كَانَ عِنْدَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَقَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَسْمَعُ : يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ، إِنْ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ الطَّائِفَ غَدًا ، فَأَنَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى ابْنَةِ غَيْلَانَ ، فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبِلُ بِأَرْبَعٍ وَتُدْبِرُ بِثَمَانٍ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : لَا يَدْخُلَنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ عَلَيْكُنَّ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by al-Qasim ibn Muhammad: Umar ibn al-Khattab had a wife from the Ansar who bore him Asim ibn Umar, then he divorced her. Umar came to Quba and found his son Asim playing in the courtyard of the mosque. He took him by his upper arm and placed him in front of him on his riding animal. The boy's grandmother caught up with him and disputed with him over the boy, until they came to Abu Bakr al-Siddiq. Umar said: 'My son.' The woman said: 'My son.' Abu Bakr al-Siddiq said: 'Leave him with her.' Umar did not oppose what Abu Bakr al-Siddiq had decided.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ ، يَقُولُ : " كَانَتْ عِنْدَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ ، فَوَلَدَتْ لَهُ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ ، ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ فَارَقَهَا ، فَجَاءَ عُمَرُ قُبَاءً فَوَجَدَ ابْنَهُ عَاصِمًا يَلْعَبُ بِفِنَاءِ الْمَسْجِدِ ، فَأَخَذَ بِعَضُدِهِ فَوَضَعَهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى الدَّابَّةِ ، فَأَدْرَكَتْهُ جَدَّةُ الْغُلَامِ فَنَازَعَتْهُ إِيَّاهُ ، حَتَّى أَتَيَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : ابْنِي . وَقَالَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ : ابْنِي . فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ : خَلِّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُ . فَمَا رَاجَعَهُ عُمَرُ فِيمَا قَضَى بِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ "

hadiths.english_translation: Yahya said: I heard Malik saying regarding a man who purchases merchandise of animals, clothing, or goods, and that sale is found to be invalid and is returned, and the one who received the merchandise is ordered to return to its owner his merchandise: Malik said: The owner of the merchandise is entitled to nothing except its value on the day it was received from him, not on the day it is returned to him, and that is because he guaranteed it from the day he received it. So whatever decrease occurred in it after that was from him, and whatever increase was for him. And he has no right to its growth nor its offspring, because if he had taken the price, he would have profited with it, so it is as if he had taken it and profited with it and invested it. And the gain of that is to offset what he has from the growth of the merchandise and its offspring.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ يَحْيَى : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا يَقُولُ ، فِي الرَّجُلِ يَبْتَاعُ السِّلْعَةَ مِنَ الْحَيَوَانِ أَوِ الثِّيَابِ أَوِ الْعُرُوضِ ، فَيُوجَدُ ذَلِكَ الْبَيْعُ غَيْرَ جَائِزٍ ، فَيُرَدُّ وَيُؤْمَرُ الَّذِي قَبَضَ السِّلْعَةَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ إِلَى صَاحِبِهِ سِلْعَتَهُ ، قَالَ مَالِك : فَلَيْسَ لِصَاحِبِ السِّلْعَةِ إِلَّا قِيمَتُهَا يَوْمَ قُبِضَتْ مِنْهُ ، وَلَيْسَ يَوْمَ يَرُدُّ ذَلِكَ إِلَيْهِ ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ ضَمِنَهَا مِنْ يَوْمَ قَبَضَهَا ، فَمَا كَانَ فِيهَا مِنْ نُقْصَانٍ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ كَانَ مِنْهُ ، وَمَا كَانَ فِيهَا مِنْ زِيَادَةٍ فَهُوَ لَهُ ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ نَمَائِهَا وَلَا مِنْ وَلَدِهَا شَيْءٌ ، لِأَنَّهُ لَوْ أَخَذَ الثَّمَنَ لَرَبِحَ فِيهِ ، فَهُوَ كَأَنَّهُ قَدْ أَخَذَهُ فَرَبِحَ فِيهِ وَتَاجَرَ ، وَرِبْحُ ذَلِكَ يُوَازِي مَا لَهُ مِنْ نَمَاءِ السِّلْعَةِ وَوَلَدِهَا

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Yahya ibn Sa'id: Abu al-Darda wrote to Salman al-Farisi: 'Come to the Holy Land.' Salman wrote back to him: 'Indeed, the land does not sanctify anyone; rather, it is a person's deeds that sanctify him. And it has reached me that you have been made a physician who treats. If you cure, then how excellent for you. But if you are a quack, then beware lest you kill a person and thus enter the Fire.' Abu al-Darda used to invoke for forgiveness whenever he passed judgment between two people until he would separate from them.

potential_issues.issue: The chain is munqati' (disconnected) - Yahya ibn Sa'id did not meet the Companions Abu al-Darda or Salman
potential_issues.impact: This is a mursal or munqati' report. However, Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari is one of the most reliable narrators of his generation, and Malik narrates from him with full confidence. Such reports about Companion interactions are often accepted when narrated by highly reliable authorities like Yahya ibn Sa'id.

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، أَنَّ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ كَتَبَ إِلَى سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ أَنْ : " هَلُمَّ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ " ، فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ سَلْمَانُ : " إِنَّ الْأَرْضَ لَا تُقَدِّسُ أَحَدًا ، وَإِنَّمَا يُقَدِّسُ الْإِنْسَانَ عَمَلُهُ ، وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ جُعِلْتَ طَبِيبًا تُدَاوِي ، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تُبْرِئُ فَنِعِمَّا لَكَ ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ مُتَطَبِّبًا فَاحْذَرْ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ إِنْسَانًا فَتَدْخُلَ النَّارَ " . فَكَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ إِذَا قَضَى بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ اسْتَغْفَرَ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ مِنْهُمَا

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abd al-Rahman ibn Dalaf al-Muzani from his father: A man from Juhaynah used to race ahead of the pilgrims and buy riding camels at inflated prices, then hasten his travel and race ahead of the pilgrims. Then he went bankrupt, so his matter was brought to Umar ibn al-Khattab. He said: 'As for what follows, O people, indeed al-Usayfi', little Usayfi' of Juhaynah, was content with his religion and trustworthiness that it be said he raced ahead of the pilgrims. Indeed, he has gone into debt showing off. And indeed, I have not found any wealth for him. So whoever wishes to extend his time (for payment), let him extend it, and whoever wishes to release him from his debt, let him release him.' Then Umar ibn al-Khattab freed him from what was owed to him.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ دَلَافٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ كَانَ يَسْبِقُ الْحَاجَّ فَيَشْتَرِي الرَّوَاحِلَ فَيُغْلِي بِهَا ، ثُمَّ يُسْرِعُ السَّيْرَ فَيَسْبِقُ الْحَاجَّ ، فَأَفْلَسَ ، فَرُفِعَ أَمْرُهُ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ، فَقَالَ : " أَمَّا بَعْدُ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ، فَإِنَّ الْأُسَيْفِعَ أُسَيْفِعَ جُهَيْنَةَ ، رَضِيَ مِنْ دِينِهِ وَأَمَانَتِهِ بِأَنْ يُقَالَ سَبَقَ الْحَاجَّ ، أَلَا وَإِنَّهُ قَدْ دَانَ مُعْرِضًا ، فَمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِالْغَدَاةِ نَقْسِمْ مَالَهُ بَيْنَ غُرَمَائِهِ " . ثُمَّ إِنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ وَضَعَ عَنْهُ مَا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ
